description: This file defines the SudoCommandResponse interface which extends command response interfaces and provides default implementations for resource path and type, along with nested JSON field definitions related to Sudo command responses in the Eclipse Ditto project.

classes.name: SudoCommandResponse
classes.description: An interface for all SudoCommand response types within the Eclipse Ditto framework, providing default behaviors and JSON field definitions relevant to sudo command responses.

methods.name: getResourcePath
methods.description: Returns an empty JSON pointer as resource path, indicating the path is not needed for SudoCommandResponses in current context.

methods.name: getResourceType
methods.description: Returns the resource type string associated with SudoCommands.

methods.name: setEntity
methods.description: Sets the JSON entity associated with the response.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Sets the Ditto headers for the response.
